title: 俗世凡尘 第25章 离散俗世凡尘 第26章 规划逃跑路线

陆多福将她紧紧负在背上，安慰道：“师姐放心，他们抓不到我们的，走。”运起灵力，一个纵身，从枯枝败叶上踏过，朝森林深处奔赴而去。
“哪里走？”两个黑衣人怎么会放过到手的猎物，朝着陆多福扑了过来。两个起落就在陆多福身后，前面的那人一爪探出，抓向陆多福背后的南宫月。南宫月回身一剑，刺向黑衣人的掌心。
南宫月练了几年，剑法有些火候的，这一剑又快又狠，差点将黑衣人的手掌刺个对穿。黑衣人吓了一跳，怒道：“小娘们居然还敢反抗。”弹开南宫月的短剑，一拳打出。
双方实力本来就悬殊，南宫月又在陆多福背上，行动不便，这一拳也就避不开，被结结实实打中了心脏。南宫月遭此重击，顿时口吐鲜血，软倒在陆多福背上。
“师姐……”陆多福惊怒出声。南宫月被打中，他当然能感觉出来，黑衣人这一拳很重，连陆多福也被推了个踉跄。
“老二，你他妈的，不是说好这小妞要先留着吗？下手这么重干嘛？”后面的那个黑衣人骂道。
前面的这黑衣人一愣：“啊，大哥，我……”就这一愣神的功夫，陆多福已经背着南宫月跑出十多步远。
“快追！”
可是这一追，两个黑衣人跑着跑着就发现不太对劲，脚下的地怎么感觉松松软软的，有点使不上劲来了。再往前两步，他们整个小腿都陷了进去，然后没至膝盖。
“大……大哥，沼……沼泽，这是沼泽呀！那小子，他怎么会……”望着前方健步如飞的陆多福，前面的这个黑衣人惊恐万分的叫道，仿佛遇见了很可怕的东西。
来不及了，他的大哥也一样，污泥刚到小腿的时候，他想退回去，可是他才一抬脚，发现使不出力，再挣扎两下，污泥已到了大腿，完全脱不了身了。
“救命啊，我不想死啊……”两个黑衣人在污泥中挣扎了一会，慢慢沉没下去，沼泽恢复了平静，仿佛什么事也没有发生一样。
黑衣人撕心裂肺的求救声，陆多福自然是听见了。等黑衣人沉下去之后，陆多福扭头朝着原路返回，背着南宫月从灌木丛中朝森林外奔去。
水平渡，真是没想到，这个看似无用且无聊的自创技能，竟然在关键时刻拯救了陆多福二人。当看见那一片洼地的时候，陆多福就推断那应该会有一片沼泽。于是当他背起南宫月逃跑的时候，就施展起水平渡了。在水面上的时候，他可以拎着把几十斤重的大铁剑挥舞，那么在沼泽上背着体健身轻的南宫月，自然不成问题。
“师姐，你撑住，我一定能找到救你的人。”森林外面，陆多福咬紧牙关，背着昏迷不醒南宫月在路上狂奔。然而这话，陆多福自己都不信。
南宫月的伤很重，黑衣人那一拳直接震裂了她心脉。虽然陆多福在云隐门被称为小神医，但是这种程度的伤，他根本治不了。现在的南宫月气若游丝，只有找到真正的神医，才有可能起死回生。
出了树林后，他看见路边上有两个黑衣人留下的坐骑烈风鹰，这是一种低等猛兽，攻击性不强，主要是用来当坐骑用。陆多福本来想骑着烈风鹰带南宫月去找人治疗，不料这两头畜生似乎颇通人性。见陆多福不是主人后，不管他怎么敲打，就是不肯受他驱使。
没办法，南宫月的伤片刻也耽搁不得，陆多福只得放弃了这两头畜生，背起南宫月在雨中狂奔。可惜的是，他这一天下来跑了太久了，现在又背了个人，体力很快就耗尽了。
“噗通！”山路湿滑，陆多福一头栽倒在地，南宫月也被摔下。陆多福想要起来，但是现在的他一点力气都没了，根本爬不起来。

宗门被灭，师父师娘和一众师叔伯均罹难。师父师娘临终前所托，第一个愿望便是保护好师姐。可才过不到一天，师姐又要离自己而去……绝望至此，陆多福紧绷的神经再也支撑不住，放声大哭起来。
“咳咳，小……福子，别……哭……”一只纤纤素手轻轻抚在陆多福脸上，为他拭去泪水。
“师姐，你醒了。我……我……对不起……”
南宫月醒了，大概是陆多福这一摔，把她摔醒过来了。
“小福子，别难过，我知道，你已经尽力了。爹爹说过，生死有命。”南宫月怜惜地望着陆多福，脸色苍白，双眸之间已经失去了往日的光彩。
陆多福怔怔地望着南宫月，他感觉嘴里好咸，好苦，如同这挨千刀的世道。他艰难地坐起身，将南宫月抱在怀里。
“小福子，抱紧我，好冷。”
阴雨连绵，两人浑身湿透，陆多福的心更是跌落冰点，他紧紧抱住南宫月，哽咽道：“师姐……”
南宫月脸上突然恢复了些许血色，轻声道：“小福子，我想听你叫我的名字，就像爹和娘叫我那样。”

Lu Duofu carried her tightly on his back and comforted her: "Sister, don't worry, they can't catch us, let's go." Using his spiritual power, he jumped up, stepped over the dead branches and leaves, and ran towards the depths of the forest.
"Where to go?" How could the two men in black let go of their prey and pounced towards Lu Duofu. The two people were standing behind Lu Duofu. The man in front stretched out his claws and grabbed Nangong Yue who was behind Lu Duofu. Nangong Yue turned around and stabbed the palm of the man in black with her sword.
Nangong Yue has been practicing for several years, and her swordsmanship is somewhat advanced. This sword was fast and fierce, and almost pierced the palm of the man in black. The man in black was startled and said angrily: "How dare you resist, little bitch." He deflected Nangong Yue's dagger and punched it out.
There was a huge disparity in strength between the two sides, and Nangong Yue was on Lu Duofu's back, making it difficult to move. The punch could not be avoided and was hit firmly in the heart. Nangong Yue was hit so hard that she immediately vomited blood and fell limply on Lu Duofu's back.
"Senior sister..." Lu Duofu said angrily. Of course he could feel that Nangong Yue was hit. The man in black punched so hard that even Lu Duofu was pushed and staggered.
"Second brother, damn you, didn't you agree to keep this girl for now? Why are you so heavy-handed?" the man in black behind cursed.
The man in black in front was stunned: "Ah, brother, I..." In this moment of confusion, Lu Duofu had already ran more than ten steps away with Nangong Yue on his back.
"Hurry up!"
However, during this chase, the two men in black realized something was not right as they ran. The ground under their feet felt loose and soft, making them unable to exert their strength. Two steps forward, their entire calves sank in, then up to their knees.
"Big...brother, swamp...swamp, this is a swamp! That boy, how could he..." Looking at Lu Duofu walking swiftly in front of him, the man in black in front shouted in horror, as if he had encountered something terrible.
It was too late, and the same was true for his elder brother. When the mud just reached his calves, he wanted to move back, but as soon as he raised his feet, he found that he couldn't use any force. After struggling twice, the mud had reached his thighs, and he couldn't get out at all.
"Help, I don't want to die..." The two men in black struggled in the mud for a while and then slowly sank. The swamp returned to calm, as if nothing happened.
Lu Duofu naturally heard the man in black's heartbreaking cry for help. After the man in black sank, Lu Duofu turned around and returned to the original path, carrying Nangong Yue and running out of the bushes towards the forest.
Horizontal crossing, I really didn’t expect that this seemingly useless and boring self-created skill actually saved Lu Duofu and the two at a critical moment. When he saw the depression, Lu Duofu deduced that there should be a swamp. So when he carried Nangong Yue on his back and ran away, he used Horizontal Crossing. When he was on the water, he could carry a large iron sword weighing dozens of kilograms and swing it, so it would not be a problem to carry the light Nangong Yue on his back in the swamp.
"Sister, hold on, I will definitely find someone to save you." Outside the forest, Lu Duofu gritted his teeth and ran on the road with the unconscious Nangong Yue on his back. However, Lu Duofu himself didn't believe this.
Nangong Yue was seriously injured, and the man in black's punch directly shattered her heart. Although Lu Duofu was known as the little miracle doctor in Yunyin Sect, he couldn't cure an injury of this degree. Now Nangong Yue's energy is like a thread, and only by finding a real miracle doctor can he be brought back to life.
After leaving the woods, he saw the Gale Eagle, a mount left by two men in black on the roadside. It was a low-level beast, not very aggressive, and was mainly used as a mount. Lu Duofu originally wanted to ride the gale eagle and take Nangong Yue to find someone for treatment, but unexpectedly, these two beasts seemed to be quite humane. After seeing that Lu Duofu was no longer his master, no matter how hard he beat him, he just refused to be driven by him.
There is no way, Nangong Yue's injury cannot be delayed for a moment,Lu Duofu had no choice but to abandon these two beasts, carry Nangong Yue on his back and run wildly in the rain. Unfortunately, he had been running for too long that day, and now he was carrying another person on his back, so his energy was quickly exhausted.
"Plop!" The mountain road was slippery, Lu Duofu fell to the ground, and Nangong Yue was also thrown down. Lu Duofu wanted to get up, but now he had no strength at all and couldn't get up at all.
The sect was destroyed, and the master, master, wife and all the masters and uncles were killed. The first wish entrusted to me by my master and my wife before she died was to protect my senior sister. But less than a day later, the senior sister was leaving him again... At this point of despair, Lu Duofu's tense nerves could no longer hold on and he burst into tears.
"Ahem, little...Fuzi, don't...cry..." A delicate hand gently caressed Lu Duofu's face and wiped away his tears.
"Sister, you're awake. I...I...I'm sorry..."
Nangong Yue woke up. It was probably Lu Duofu's fall that woke her up.
"Xiao Fuzi, don't be sad. I know that you have tried your best. Dad said that life and death are determined by fate." Nangong Yue looked at Lu Duofu with pity, her face was pale, and her eyes had lost their former glory.
Lu Duofu stared at Nangong Yue blankly. He felt his mouth was so salty and bitter, just like in this world where he had suffered a thousand cuts. He sat up with difficulty and held Nangong Yue in his arms.
"Xiao Fuzi, hold me tight, it's so cold."
It was raining continuously, and the two of them were soaked. Lu Duofu's heart dropped to freezing point. He hugged Nangong Yue tightly and choked out: "Senior sister..."
Nangong Yue suddenly regained some color on her face, and said softly: "Xiao Fuzi, I want to hear you call my name, just like my father and mother call me."
